# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.83

This maintenance release rebuilds the latest BlockBuddies main application
after synchronising with `main` and keeps the stable Android update path
introduced in v1.5.82.

## Included gameplay

- The wide Buddy Grand Prix circuit with room for four Local Party racers.
- Active-racer-only kart rendering so unused cars do not block the track.
- Blue, purple, and red light sabers with HUD blade controls.
- The Hovering Void Orb pet and Shadow Oracle outfit.

## Android update behaviour

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Uses the same stable test certificate as v1.5.82, allowing v1.5.83 to update
  an installed v1.5.82 build normally.
- Includes automated package-name, app-label, signature, and checksum checks.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.83.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `SIGNING-CERTIFICATE.txt`
- `APK-BADGING.txt`

## Validation

- ESLint and Oxlint
- TypeScript type checking
- Vitest unit and component tests
- Production web build
- Capacitor Android sync
- Android APK assembly and signature verification

The downloadable APK uses a stable public test certificate for direct testing.
Play Store signing remains a separate release step.
